title: Kenyan Braised Guanciale Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew made with guanciale, juicy beef, and spices inspired by Kenyan cuisine.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and black pepper.
Heat the guanciale in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat until crispy.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste, curry powder, and cumin to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
